replay.source: Chronological reconstruction from frozen predictions; score availability approximated by 18h embargo

frozen.source: Truly prospective: shadow projection frozen before tipoff

shadow_score_calibration.rollout_gate: No promotion until at least 100 distinct future games have frozen shadow scores, both total and margin MAE improve by at least 5% versus the raw model, and a separate calibration review approves the change. Winner probabilities are NOT recalibrated.

retrospective.source: Post-hoc fixed arithmetic using independent scores originally frozen before tipoff; NOT prospective validation of these variants

frozen.source: Variants explicitly frozen together with the original pregame capture; graded only after final

ensemble_score_audit.rollout_gate: Only independently review 50/50 after 100 new distinct, genuinely frozen games with >=5% lower total AND margin MAE vs unblended possession scores. All model win probabilities, market prices, props and picks remain unchanged.

retrospective.method: Walk-forward earlier box scores only; historical injuries and roster announcements unavailable. Does NOT validate the current injury-adjusted model.

market_baseline.reason: Server has no historical frozen game-market quotes. Actual entered spread/total/ML comparisons are frozen and graded on the user device.

promotion: OFF: no independently approved prospective calibration or betting-edge evidence
limits: No shadow correction is applied to live scores, market estimates, or player props. Score correction needs prospective frozen grading and a separate human approval. Current rest/venue/rotation effects remain explicit hypotheses.
